lines.trans: Our very first meeting, Mr Chun Yuqiao.
Mr Wen Simo, this is the backstage area.
Is an on-camera face like mine not welcome back here?
What advice do you have for me?

words.gloss: what advice do you have for me?
words.gram: Meaning: what advice do you have for me?.

lines.trans: You flatter me—you are a gold-medal producer.
I have worked with many producers and directors, yet allow me one word of friendly advice.
There is really no need to be so harsh on your staff, especially in front of foreign guests.
Mr Wen Simo, I have my own sense of measure in how I act.
No matter who is standing in front of me, I am simply being myself.
Was that temperament the reason you left your previous network back then?
The reason I left that network back then was a woman, as you know.
